text.p: Shares in pay television operator Australis Media Ltd topped turnover in morning trade on Monday with 23.58 million shares traded.
The bulk of the trade was in one line of 22.88 million shares specialled through Macquarie Equities at a price of A$0.11 per share.
A spokesman for Australis was unavailable for comment.
The parcel of shares put through Macquarie is below the compulsory disclosure level of five percent.

Brokers said that while long-standing speculation was that Kerry Packer, who took an interest in Australis as part of its refinancing late in 1996, would increase his stake at some stage, he was unlikely to move yet.
"We have all heard that Kerry packer is eyeing Australis up and down but I doubt whether he would be moving on it yet," said a Brisbane dealer.
By 2.40 p.m. (0140 GMT), Australis shares were 1.5 cents higher at 13 cents on turnover of 23.96 million shares.
